code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
D=os.getcwd()
cs=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D,"fmc1_conservation_structure.csv"))
al=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D,"fmc1_alignment_columns.csv"))
tm=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D,"tmalign_lite_fmc1_vs_targets.csv"))
mts=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D,"mts_heuristics.csv"))
ref="".join(al['ref'])
helices=[(2,23,'a1'),(33,49,'a2'),(55,81,'a3'),(85,100,'a4')]
patch1=[65,68,72,75,78,79,80,81]; patch2=[98,99,100,103]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,11))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.15,1,1],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.25)

# --- A: conservation / burial / pLDDT track
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ax.bar(cs.pos,cs.cons,color=np.where(cs.exposed,'#3b7dd8','#b9c6d9'),width=0.85)
ax.plot(cs.pos,cs.pLDDT/100,color='#d1495b',lw=1.2,label='pLDDT / 100')
for a,b,n in helices:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((a-0.5,1.02),b-a+1,0.07,color='#444'))
    ax.text((a+b)/2,1.13,n,ha='center',fontsize=9)
for p in patch1: ax.plot(p,-0.05,marker='^',color='#e07b39',ms=7,clip_on=False)
for p in patch2: ax.plot(p,-0.05,marker='^',color='#5d9e5d',ms=7,clip_on=False)
for p in [7,8,9]: ax.plot(p,-0.05,marker='v',color='#7b3fa0',ms=7,clip_on=False)
ax.set_xlim(0,105); ax.set_ylim(-0.1,1.25)
ax.set_xlabel('S. pombe fmc1 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('column conservation (1 - H/Hmax)')
ax.set_title('A  Conservation across 37 FMC1 orthologs mapped on the AlphaFold model\n'
             'blue = surface exposed, grey = buried; orange triangles = conserved surface patch 1, green = patch 2, purple = LYR motif V7-Y8-R9',
             loc='left',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper right')
ax.set_xticks(range(0,105,5))
ax.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=7)

# --- B: LYR motif column composition
axb=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
pos=list(range(5,21))
mat=[]
order='AVLIMFWYCGPSTNQHKRDE'
for p in pos:
    c=Counter([x for x in str(al.loc[p-1,'column']) if x!='-'])
    tot=sum(c.values()); mat.append([100*c.get(a,0)/tot for a in order])
mat=np.array(mat).T
im=axb.imshow(mat,aspect='auto',cmap='Blues',vmin=0,vmax=100)
axb.set_yticks(range(len(order))); axb.set_yticklabels(list(order),fontsize=7)
axb.set_xticks(range(len(pos))); axb.set_xticklabels([f"{ref[p-1]}{p}" for p in pos],fontsize=7,rotation=90)
axb.set_title('B  Helix a1 / LYR-motif column composition (% of 37 orthologs)',loc='left',fontsize=10)
for i,p in enumerate(pos):
    if p in (7,8,9): axb.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((i-0.5,-0.5),1,len(order),fill=False,ec='#7b3fa0',lw=1.8))
plt.colorbar(im,ax=axb,fraction=0.03)

# --- C: TM-scores
axc=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
tm=tm.sort_values('TMscore_norm_min')
colors=['#7b3fa0' if 'FMC1' in t else ('#3b7dd8' if 'LYRM' in t or t in('SDHAF1','NDUFA6_LYRM6','NDUFB9_LYRM3','SDHAF3_LYRM10') else '#c0392b' if ('ATP' in t or 'TMEM' in t) else '#888') for t in tm.target]
axc.barh(tm.target,tm.TMscore_norm_min,color=colors)
axc.axvline(0.3,ls=':',c='k',lw=1)
axc.set_xlabel('TM-score (query-normalised, simplified TM-align)')
axc.set_title('C  Fold similarity of fmc1 to orthologs (purple), other LYRM proteins (blue),\n     candidate partners ATPAF2/ATPAF1/ATP5F1A/TMEM70 (red), controls (grey)',loc='left',fontsize=9)
axc.tick_params(labelsize=7)

# --- D: MTS heuristics
axd=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
grp=lambda n: ('FMC1' if 'FMC1' in n or 'fmc1' in n else ('LYRM' if n in('LYRM4_ISD11','NDUFA6_LYRM6','SDHAF1') else 'cleavable-presequence control'))
cmap={'FMC1':'#7b3fa0','LYRM':'#3b7dd8','cleavable-presequence control':'#c0392b'}
for _,r in mts.iterrows():
    g=grp(r['protein']); axd.scatter(r['net_charge_1_30'],r['muH_1_20'],c=cmap[g],s=70,zorder=3)
    axd.annotate(r['protein'].replace('(+ctrl)',''),(r['net_charge_1_30'],r['muH_1_20']),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords='offset points')
axd.set_xlabel('net charge, residues 1-30'); axd.set_ylabel('hydrophobic moment, residues 1-20')
axd.set_title('D  N-terminal targeting heuristics: fmc1 is indistinguishable from\n     LYRM proteins that have no cleavable presequence',loc='left',fontsize=9)
h=[plt.Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color=v,label=k) for k,v in cmap.items()]
axd.legend(handles=h,fontsize=7)

# --- E: interaction evidence
axe=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1]); axe.axis('off')
txt=("E  Physical-interaction evidence (IntAct / GO)\n\n"
     "S. cerevisiae Fmc1  -  Atp12p        TAP-MS, PMID 16429126\n"
     "S. cerevisiae fmc1D rescued by ATP12 overexpression   PMID 11096112\n"
     "Human FMC1  -  ATPAF2 (Atp12)     co-IP, PMID 27499296\n"
     "Human FMC1  -  ATPAF2               co-IP, PMID 28514442\n"
     "Human FMC1  -  ATPAF2               co-IP, PMID 33961781\n"
     "Human FMC1  -  NDUFAB1 (mtACP)  co-IP, PMID 27499296\n"
     "Human FMC1  -  ATP5F1A / ATP5F1B   co-IP, PMID 27499296\n"
     "S. pombe fmc1: no interaction record in IntAct\n\n"
     "Current GO for S. pombe fmc1 (QuickGO):\n"
     "  MF GO:0003674  ND (no data)\n"
     "  BP GO:0033615  IEA (InterPro) + IBA\n"
     "  CC GO:0005759  IBA ;  GO:0005739  IEA\n"
     "  -> no experimental annotation in S. pombe")
axe.text(0,1,txt,va='top',fontsize=9,family='monospace')
plt.show()
